## Self-review checklist
- [ ] Every change traces to an acceptance criterion (or is noted as a backlog item)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm eval` shows no metric drop > 2 pts (or the baseline update is justified)
- [ ] No floats for money; no `any` without a comment
- [ ] Docs updated (design, ADRs, CHANGELOG, learning log)
- [ ] No secrets committed; `.env.example` updated if new env vars
